name: torahlearningtools
description: Monorepo for the small Torah-learning projects hosted on torahlearningtools.com. Each app in apps/ installs its own dependencies from its own package-lock.json (no npm workspaces).

scripts.install:all: for d in apps/*/; do (cd "$d" && npm ci) || exit 1; done
scripts.test:all: for d in apps/*/; do npm --prefix "$d" test --if-present || exit 1; done
scripts.build:all: for d in apps/*/; do npm --prefix "$d" run build || exit 1; done
